user.title: Account Login
user.description: Enter your Xiaomi car account (phone number), password, and the Device ID from the Xiaomi Car app on your phone. An SMS verification code will be sent.

code.title: SMS Verification Code
code.description: A verification code has been sent to {username}, enter it below:

data_description.deviceId: The Device ID (deviceId) of the Xiaomi Car app on your phone — it must match the app exactly. How to find it: capture traffic (e.g. ProxyPin) while using the app, then look for the mobileId or deviceId value in the request cookie/body. See README for details.

error.invalid_device_id: Invalid Device ID: it must match the Xiaomi Car app on your phone (letters/digits/-/_ characters, e.g. YSFTVmttfxS0t_G-). See README for how to find it.
